description: Applications (consumers) that were throttled (HTTP 429) in a time window: count, owner, API, throttle reason, first and last throttled call. Use for 'who is being throttled', 'rate limits hit', 'noisy consumers'.

configuration.query: FROM apim_event_faulty | WHERE errorType == "THROTTLED" AND DATE_DIFF("minute", requestTimestamp, NOW()) <= ?lookback_minutes | STATS throttled=COUNT(*), first_seen=MIN(requestTimestamp), last_seen=MAX(requestTimestamp) BY applicationName, applicationOwner, apiName, errorMessage | SORT throttled DESC | LIMIT 20

lookback_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (e.g. 60 for the last hour, 1440 for a day).
